capabilities: Evaluate arithmetic expressions ending in = with parentheses, powers, and remainder
Display formatted answers inline without modifying the note source
Support currency symbols and comma-grouped numbers in operands
Copy answers or complete formulas with answers via click or selection
disambiguation: Not a full calculator or spreadsheet; it only evaluates lines ending in = and never writes generated answers back into the file.
extras: The README is largely a release-preparation document: installation is manual from a repository checkout (build main.js, manifest.json, styles.css yourself), and desktop/mobile compatibility beyond manifest declarations is described as externally unverified. No arbitrary-precision math, currency conversion, or percentage operator is supported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to evaluate arithmetic written directly inside a note, so simple calculations require leaving the note or editing the text to insert results.
summary: Inline calculator that displays arithmetic answers beside expressions ending in = in Live Preview and Reading view, without saving answers into the Markdown file.
